title: Noor and the House
author: Sable Dravenmoor
blurb: Noor Vane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
